svg.text: ATLAS_C / CONCEPTUAL / CL04 / Historical admission remains source-bound
G54D1 continued an existing lineage with authorized correction 4.
G54B1 and G54D remain INCOMPLETE. This was not one-shot authorship.
New request -> current sources -> bounded Work -> local Root -> scoped effect
The audit Reader explains evidence; it is not the Authoring Kit or hidden oracle.
